development.description: Native dev-client build for real devices. Required to debug custom native modules (react-native-maps, expo-file-system) that Expo Go cannot host.

preview.description: Optimized release build for the internal team loop: installable APK on Android, ad-hoc IPA on iOS.

production.description: Store build: AAB for Google Play and IPA for the App Store. Release/production Metro optimization (minified Hermes bytecode), auto-incremented versions.
